title: SONIC-O1: A Real-World Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models on Audio-Video Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model task performance (summarization quality, multiple-choice question accuracy, and temporal localization) stratified by the perceived race or ethnicity of the individuals in the video (Arab, Indigenous, Asian, White, Hispanic, Black).
Measuring and comparing multimodal task performance across videos featuring male versus female participants to identify systemic disparities in how the models process different genders.

Stratifying and analyzing model performance metrics across distinct perceived age groups (18-24, 25-39, and 40+) to assess whether models exhibit robustness failures or advantages based on speaker age.
